body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> HD-PLC Alliance displayed a wide range of PLC adaptors, routers, and compatible peripherals at the 2009 International CES in Las Vegas. A lineup of second-generation PLC modules that can enable HD-PLC functionality to existing technology will also be on display.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
